items.note: Checked the Stadtzeitung Nr. 12 of 10.06.2026 notice: Gemeinderat resolved the Satzung on 30.04.2026 (Neufassung); par. 7 says it takes effect 01.01.2027 and replaces the Parkgebuehrenordnung of 1 Oct 1985 as amended 01.03.2011. Zones/prices/max stays match exactly (Zone I EUR 1.00 per started 20 min, 1 h, daily 8-18; II 1.00/30 min, 2 h; III 0.50/30 min, 4 h; IV 0.20/30 min or EUR 4 day ticket; II-IV weekdays 8-18). Wording correctly says 'stated to take effect', not in force. Title matches the notice heading.

Official consolidated ordinance (Stand 17.08.2022): last amendment 03.02.11, in force 01.03.11; Zone I 0.50 per started 20 min, Zone II 0.50 per 30 min, Zone III 0.20 per 30 min. That the 2026 Satzung replaces it is stated in par. 7 of the 2026 notice (item 0), not on this page, but is correct. Title is the real document title.

Notice of 10.06.2026: Rechtsverordnung dated 05.05.2026 (issued by the Oberbuergermeister); par. 4 fees EUR 120 per year / EUR 60 per six months; par. 6 in force 01.07.2026 except par. 4, 'Gebuehrenerhoehung wird zum 01.01.2027 wirksam'; zones 101-117 for the inner city. Text correctly says the increase is stated to become effective 1 Jan 2027. Title matches. Page does not give the previous fee level (draft does not claim it).

echo24 of 17.06.2023: rates constant since 2011, ordinance under revision, no concrete plans/prices to be announced; city says planned resident-permit increase was put on hold in 2022 indefinitely. All as stated. h1 matches title.

SWHN notice of 10 Jan 2024: supervisory board decided on 29.11.2023; daily maximum 12 to 14 EUR at Lohtorstrasse car park, Bollwerksturm, Wohlgelegen, Neckarbogen interim car park; Wohlgelegen hourly 1.50 to 2.00; Bollwerksturm resident/night tariff no longer offered. Page says tariffs adjusted 'zum Jahreswechsel' (not literally '1 January 2024'), so the exact date is a close inference; Wohlgelegen increase is worded 'soll angehoben werden'. Acceptable. Note page title tag has 'Meldung:' prefix, h1 does not.

Stimme 25.11.2025: B&B Parkhaus GmbH runs Wollhaus, Harmonie and K3 garages; 'seit Oktober 2025 etwas mehr', 'nach Stimme-Informationen die erste Preiserhoehung nach einigen Jahren'; Bollwerksturm EUR 2.50 per started hour, daily max EUR 16 - all correct. Overstated: the page says Experimenta and the Mitte/Ost campus garages are 'guenstiger' (cheaper) than the others it lists, not 'the cheapest'. It also covers only 'ausgewaehlte' garages.
items.corrected_text: A Heilbronner Stimme price comparison of selected city-centre garages reported that B&B Parkhaus GmbH, which it names as operator of the Wollhaus, Harmonie and K3 garages, had charged somewhat more since October 2025, which the paper described as the first rise in some years. It lists Bollwerksturm (SWHN) at 2.50 EUR per started hour with a 16 EUR daily maximum, and describes the Experimenta and campus garages as cheaper.

items.note: SWHN notice of 14 May 2024: opening ceremony 13 May 2024, 643 Stellplaetze, EUR 2 million funding from the BW transport ministry, 'rund einem Jahr Bauzeit'; SWHN builder/operator. Title is the h1 (page title tag adds 'Meldung:').
Same page: 202 Elektro-Ladepunkte, Vorruestungen for further points on the remaining spaces, Wallboxes max 11 kW per point, operated by Stadtwerke Heilbronn.

electrive (23.09.2021, updated 06.03.2024) was Cloudflare-blocked for curl; text obtained via WebFetch. Page says the city owns the NEW chargers at municipal buildings (18 stations / 36 points) with SWHN as operator; separately ('Davon abgesehen') SWHN operates 26 further points in the Bollwerksturm and SLK-Klinikum garages. City ownership is not stated for the 26 garage points. The 11 kW and app/EC-terminal sentence follows the municipal-charger paragraph, so it cannot be attributed to the garage points with certainty.
items.corrected_text: A trade-press report said that, apart from 36 new charge points at municipal buildings (owned by the city, operated by SWHN), SWHN operates 26 further charge points in the Bollwerksturm garage and the SLK clinic garage at Gesundbrunnen.

items.note: electrive 24.02.2025 (read via WebFetch because direct fetch blocked): 200 car spaces equipped with charging; garage has room for 423 cars; used jointly by surrounding companies, not publicly accessible, described as 'halb-oeffentlich'. Title matches.

AGB PDF 'Stand: April 2026': entry media depend on facility and include camera licence-plate recognition, paper ticket etc.; at plate-recognition sites no parking proof is issued; plate data deleted within 24 hours after exit + payment. Title matches the document heading.

Parkgebuehrensatzung par. 5(3): payment via app of Smartparking Plattform e.V. providers counts as proper payment and replaces payment at the meter; par. 6: card payment only at partly equipped machines. Note the ordinance takes effect 1 Jan 2027 (the text's 'names' wording does not claim otherwise). Date 2026-06 is the publication date; adoption was 30.04.2026.

echo24 of 29.07.2021: start first planned end 2021, now probably 2022; 8 garages connected now, 4 more added (12); signs with free-space display 27 to 31; first signs still to be put up this year. Describes a plan/contract award, no go-live. Title is the h1 (page title tag differs).

PDF cover: 'Mobilitaetskonzept fuer die Stadt Heilbronn - Erstellung in fuenf Phasen - Massnahmenkatalog', Auftraggeber Stadt Heilbronn, Amt fuer Strassenwesen, Stuttgart/Aachen April 2019; measure 6b 'Neuordnung des ruhenden Kfz-Verkehrs (mehr/weniger, innen/aussen, Parkgebuehren)' with 'je naeher zum Zentrum, desto teurer' and P+R at ÖPNV stops, phrased as 'sollte/notwendig' recommendations. Content fine. The title in the draft is composed: 'Drucksache 294/2019' appears only in the file name, not in the document text. PDF metadata title is the real title.
items.corrected_title: Mobilitätskonzept für die Stadt Heilbronn - Maßnahmenkatalog

items.note: echo24 of 04.05.2020: Gerberstrasse, Lammgasse, Lohtorstrasse, Zehentgasse, Turmstrasse made one zone 'ab sofort'; ticket obligation every day incl. Sundays/holidays; max stay stays two hours. Title is the h1.

echo24 of 08.09.2020: SPD proposals, administration to calculate costs, decisions in budget deliberations - correct. But the page says parking spaces on Lohtorstrasse 'im Bereich der Fussgaengerzone' should be dropped (not parking on Lohtorstrasse generally), and public on-street parking in the northern centre cut by one third (not 'about').
items.corrected_text: In September 2020 the SPD council group proposed reducing car traffic in the northern centre, including removing the parking spaces on Lohtorstrasse in the pedestrian-zone section and cutting on-street public parking in the northern centre by a third. The report presents these as proposals for which the administration is to calculate costs, with decisions left to budget deliberations.

items.note: echo24 of 13.07.2023: no Stadtbahn on Kaiserstrasse from 3 July to end of August; rail renewal 3 July to 6 September (Bahnhofstrasse between Willy-Brandt-Platz and Gerberstrasse, plus a 200 m Kaiserstrasse section), works due to finish 31 August; bus replacement; Friedrich-Ebert-Bruecke closed to individual traffic during the whole construction. The article itself is inconsistent on end date (31 Aug vs 6 Sep), so 'about 6 September' is acceptable.

echo24 of 04.09.2026: 60 public spaces on Karlstrasse between Goethestrasse and Friedhofstrasse lost by changing perpendicular to parallel parking; marking work from Thursday 10 September; city cites dangerous situations between cars and cyclists (Radschulwegplaene). Title is the h1.

echo24 of 29.07.2023 is an opinion commentary (Kubasik), not a news report. It says investor Arthur Neufeld's Wollhauszentrum plans 'im Gemeinderat wie eine Bombe eingeschlagen sind' (market hall, large retail areas, green space, housing); 2028 appears only in a photo-gallery caption. It does not mention garages or B&B Parkhaus; that link comes from a different item. Title in the draft is wrong: real h1 is 'Neues Wollhaus waere eine riesige Chance fuer die Heilbronner Innenstadt'.
items.corrected_text: A local commentary of 29 July 2023 said investor Arthur Neufeld's plans for a new Wollhaus centre, with a market hall, large retail areas, green space and housing, had made a strong impression in the city council. A photo-gallery caption says the Wollhaus is meant to look this way in 2028; the piece treats it as plans only.
items.corrected_title: Neues Wollhaus wäre eine riesige Chance für die Heilbronner Innenstadt

items.note: echo24 of 22.07.2026 (citing dpa): Galeria reviews 33 locations nationwide; main reasons per company high rent burden and earning power; negotiating with Heilbronn landlords; no date for final decision. Title is the h1.

echo24 article is dated 03.10.2019, three days BEFORE the end: it says BUGA 'am 6. Oktober schliesst', '173 Tage ... fast vorbei', 'mehr als zwei Millionen Besucher'. So it cannot state that BUGA 'closed' on 6 Oct, and the balance is a pre-closing one, not final. Title: the draft's wording is neither the h1 ('Buga 2019 vor Finale: Was lief gut - und was nicht?') nor the title tag ('Heilbronn: Buga 2019 Abschluss-Bilanz kurz vor dem Ende').
items.corrected_text: A local report of 3 October 2019, shortly before the end, said BUGA 2019 would close on 6 October after 173 days, and that organisers counted more than two million visitors by then.
items.corrected_title: Buga 2019 vor Finale: Was lief gut - und was nicht?

items.note: Noerr press release 17.12.2025: ETH Zurich to build up 15 professorships in Heilbronn on responsible digital transformation, funded by Dieter Schwarz Stiftung incl. new university buildings on the Bildungscampus; research of the first professorships to start 2026. Title matches.

corrected_summary: Heilbronn's city council adopted a new on-street parking fee ordinance on 30 April 2026, stated to take effect on 1 January 2027, and a resident-permit fee ordinance dated 5 May 2026 sets the fee at EUR 120 a year with the increase effective 1 January 2027. The city's utility company SWHN adjusted tariffs at several car parks at the turn of 2023/24 and opened the Neckarbogen E-Quartiersgarage (643 spaces, 202 charge points) in May 2024. Other sourced items cover a 2021 plan to renew the dynamic parking guidance system, licence-plate entry at SWHN car parks, and local news on road works, a parking removal on Karlstrasse and a Galeria store review in 2026.
